data.narrative:
AbCellera is a public-stage biotech and health company founded by Hansen, Lecault, Heyries, Da Costa, Lisaingo, and Petriv. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 3 public peers in the same sector and stage: Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Freenome, and Alto Neuroscience.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach here. The three same-sector, same-stage comparables traded at a median valuation of $1.1B, with a range spanning $1.0B (Alto Neuroscience) to $1.6B (Recursion Pharmaceuticals). This median directly anchors the analysis. A public-comp anchoring approach using sector price-to-sales multiples—the median P/S across three public tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) stands at 9.2x—cannot be applied due to the absence of target revenue data.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $935M (low) to $1.3B (high), centered on $1.1B. The narrow method count (one applicable approach) and reliance on a small peer set of three comparables represent the principal sources of uncertainty. Variability in peer valuations ($600M spread between min and max) further limits confidence in precision. Without revenue disclosure or additional valuation methods, the median estimate of $1.1B should be treated as a directional anchor rather than a point estimate.
